The recent key authors and reviewer all used Codex, despite the configured author priority.
I set [reviewer priority](../policy/params.yml) to Claude, Codex, then Copilot to prefer another model family.
Claude has a recorded quota limit. Codex remains available as a fallback; work does not wait.
The previous cold-read and Finish rules worked in review #574. Both rules stay.
Iterations 0117–0119 report no failed sessions, limit events or quota waits. Subscription quota savings remain unmeasured.
[Evidence](../policy/observations/0120-policy-check.md) records actual read order, model use, source hashes and the decision.
The current key changes seven mappings and retains 422. Its source-grounding key remains blocked by missing preservation evidence.
I updated [policy memory](../policy/working-memory.md) and wrote empty policy orders. The shaper owns the next goal task.
Checks passed for YAML syntax, the exact parameter change, orders JSON and whitespace.
No LabVIEW result, benchmark readiness, owner method acceptance or product quality measurement follows. Artifact and version coverage remain incomplete.

## What next

The shaper should order the separate semantic recheck of the saved mapping corrections and blocked grading rules.
The next Policymaker should compare actual reviewer and author models. Configured priority does not prove model use.
Reuse the saved evidence. Do not repeat cold derivation, completed probes or review preservation.
A new complete-map example needs the missing inventories and separate review before the source-grounding block can be removed.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
